dedupe_keys.name: project 8 transportation infrastructure performance under seismic hazards with simcenter tools

description: Project 8: Transportation Infrastructure Performance under Seismic Hazards with SimCenter Tools is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Miguel Gomez Fuentes, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This is Project 8 of the 2024 NHERI Computational Academy, focused on evaluating the seismic performance of highway transportation infrastructure in the San Francisco Bay Area. The project utilized SimCenter tools, including both the frontend graphical user interface and the backend Python codebase, to achieve its goals. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Seismic Assessment of Transportation Network, Earthquake Simulations, Regional Simulations. Published 2024-10-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
